info.title: getBible.Life Telegram Mini App API
info.description: Same-origin API contract for the getBible.Life Telegram Mini App. Telegram initData is revalidated on every authenticated request. Verse text is never accepted as authoritative input for basket or post operations.

servers.description: Relative to the Mini App document base

post.summary: Create or safely recover a bounded Mini App session

200.description: A reopened Telegram WebView was rebound to its still-active owner/chat session

201.description: Validated Telegram session and initial application state

409.description: The signed Telegram launch data has already been exchanged

get.summary: Resume and hydrate an existing WebView-tab session

200.description: Current session state with the same active bearer

delete.summary: Revoke the current Mini App session
delete.description: Revocation is serialized behind an active post so an accepted post is never interrupted halfway through.

post.summary: Signal browser readiness and clean retained launch messages
post.description: Authenticates the current bearer and its original Telegram initData, then removes the bot launch prompt and ephemeral source command as one idempotent cleanup unit. The browser treats transport failure as non-fatal after a session has opened.

204.description: Launch-message cleanup completed or was already complete

403.description: Request origin is not the configured Mini App origin

put.summary: Persist validated preferences for the Telegram user
put.description: The sole writer for preferred translation and reader location. The complete update is validated before it is committed atomically.

get.summary: List books available for a translation
List chapters available for a book

post.summary: Load one canonical chapter for reading and selection
post.description: Read-only chapter retrieval. Loading Scripture does not change durable translation or reader preferences.

200.description: Chapter verses with server-issued selection identifiers

get.summary: Read a page from an authenticated search result set

post.description: The server resolves selection_id to canonical repository data. The client cannot supply verse text.

patch.summary: Set the posting order for the current basket

delete.summary: Remove one verse from the current basket

post.summary: Send a bounded bookmark backup to the authenticated user's private bot chat

200.description: The portable JSON document was delivered exactly once

get.summary: Load and validate the Telegram file attached to this one-time restore launch

200.description: Validated bookmark document ready for an explicit browser merge

delete.summary: Acknowledge a successful browser merge and consume this restore launch reference

get.summary: Load the reviewed global bookmark catalogue overlay
get.description: Returns a privacy-safe cumulative overlay for the bundled catalogue. The Mini App validates and caches it, while retaining the bundled catalogue as its offline fallback.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's contributor status

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include private topic outcomes and review counts. Omit for the legacy four-field response.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include private topic outcomes and review counts. Omit for the legacy four-field response.

post.summary: Submit a bounded idempotent contributor event batch
post.description: Accepts English topic metadata and translation-independent verse coordinates only. Scripture text and Telegram identity fields are never accepted from the browser.

event_ids.description: Opaque contributor-scoped receipt IDs keyed by client_event_id. Values are stable for exact replays and do not expose internal moderation row IDs.

post.summary: Atomically validate and post the browser selection through the bot
post.description: The browser submits only bounded coordinate identities. The server validates every book, chapter, and verse and never accepts client-provided Scripture text or references.

telegramInitData.name: X-Telegram-Init-Data
telegramInitData.description: Raw Telegram WebApp.initData. Never log or persist this value.

Unauthorized.description: Telegram launch data or bearer session is invalid or expired

InvalidRequest.description: The bounded request was invalid, stale, or conflicted with server state

RateLimited.description: The per-user or per-chat rate limit was reached

InternalError.description: An unexpected server failure prevented the request from completing

ContributionUnavailable.description: Contributor synchronization is temporarily unavailable; the client must retain its last known eligible state and retry

SelectionId.description: Opaque, server-issued identifier bound to the authenticated session and canonical verse.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag used to resolve the Mini App interface catalog.

direction.description: Reading direction applied to the selected translation and interface.

text.description: Display text is additionally limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

diacritics.description: Librarian's diacritics policy, passed through unaltered. "fold" removes accents, vowel pointing and precomposed letters so unaccented Greek, unpointed Hebrew and unvowelled Arabic reach the text; "exact" distinguishes pointed from unpointed.

BookmarkBackup.description: Portable GetBible markings JSON, canonically bounded to 4 MiB. Robot treats all bookmark display text as backup data, never as authoritative Scripture.

published.description: True only after this source mapping has reached the live catalogue. It can remain true while a later edit or delete is pending.

ContributionTopicOutcomes.description: Private local-to-canonical outcomes scoped to the authenticated numeric Telegram user. Contributor identity is never included.

mapped.description: All retained local-to-canonical mappings, including sources reopened for a later proposal; published is a subset.

name.description: English base topic name; translations are added in a later repository iteration.

diacritics.description: Librarian's diacritics policy, passed through unaltered. "fold" removes accents, vowel pointing and precomposed letters so unaccented Greek, unpointed Hebrew and unvowelled Arabic reach the text; "exact" distinguishes pointed from unpointed.

Limits.description: Server-declared budgets the page must honour. The browser cannot infer how long the robot will work on a request, and abandoning one early reports a timeout for work that was still in progress.

search_timeout_seconds.description: Longest the robot will spend on one search, including the one-off index build the first search of a translation triggers.
